pedido: Short: "The Explosion That Flattened 80 Million Trees, and Left No Crater" (Tunguska event, 1908, Siberia). A blast ~1,000x Hiroshima flattened 2,000 km2 of forest, knocked people off chairs 60 km away, night skies glowed in Europe. Expeditions found no crater and no meteorite. Build the mystery, then reveal: an asteroid or comet exploded in the air ~5-10 km up (airburst), so nothing hit the ground. Hook: "Something exploded over Siberia with 1,000 times the power of Hiroshima. Nobody found what hit."

videos.title: The Tunguska Explosion: What Blew Up Over Siberia? #shorts
videos.description:
Could it happen again over a city? 👇

The Tunguska event of 1908: what exploded over Siberia and left no crater?
It flattened about 80 million trees, yet no meteorite was ever found. The answer is an airburst.
